method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Compilation No. 232, compilation date 1 July 2026, includes amendments up to Act No. 17, 2025 (register id C2026C00336, in 6 volumes), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/C2004A04121.txt; amendments commencing on or after 20 September 2026 may be missing (no registered compilation yet). The Impairment Tables Determination 2023 and the Adult Disability Assessment Tool are not deposited; indexed rates, limits and free areas are inputs

scope: Pension age (s 23(5A)-(5D)); qualifying residence (s 7(5)); age pension qualification and payability (ss 43(1)(a)-(c), 44(1)) with the ordinary income and assets tests of Pension Rate Calculator A (point 1064-A1 Steps 1-11, Modules E and G, Table G-1; figures in force and the lost reduction formulas as inputs); Commonwealth seniors health card (s 1061ZG, s 1071); disability support pension (ss 94(1), (2), (3A), (3B), (6), 103(2); the Impairment Tables rating as an input); jobseeker payment (s 593(1)) and the liquid assets test waiting period (ss 14A, 598); youth allowance for a full-time student (ss 540, 543-543B) and the parental income test (1067G-A1 Step 13, Module F); carer allowance for a disabled adult (ss 954, 954A, 957A, 23(14)); carer payment for a disabled adult (ss 197(1), 198(2)(a), (3)-(5), (7)); compensation recovery (s 17(1)-(3), (4A); ss 1166, 1167, 1169, 1170, 1173). From the seat of the claimant, for the three WA cradle-to-grave lives.
seat: the claimant (the pensioner, the jobseeker, the person with a disability, the student, the carer): 'Am I qualified, and at what rate will I be paid?'
